home.heroBody: Bespoke couture gowns, cut, sculpted and finished by hand in the UAE, with your name stitched on the label inside.
home.houseTitle: Every gown begins with a conversation, never a cart.
home.houseBody: Then a corset built in phases, florals sculpted and stitched by hand, and a final fitting before your gown leaves the atelier in its black ROYA box.
home.houseFilm: ROYA bride in the MEHR gown, walking under the trees
home.mehrBody: Strapless duchess satin, a draped sash, and florals sculpted petal by petal.
home.mehrAlt: The MEHR bride lifting her veil as she walks
home.commissionBody: A gown that exists once. Designed with you, built around your measurements, and signed with your name.
home.commissionNote: Price on request · {percent}% deposit to begin
home.step1Body: On WhatsApp, Instagram, or in person at the atelier.
home.step2Body: Hand-drawn sketches and samples, approved by you.
home.step3Title: Built in phases, shared with you
home.step3Body: Corset, sculpting, fittings. Atelier films at every stage.
home.step4Body: Delivered in the black ROYA box, your name on the label.
home.shotPearls: Hand-sewing pearls into an organza blossom
home.shotCorset: Corset structure inside a ROYA gown
home.shotLabel: The ROYA label inside a finished gown
home.atelierBody: Corsetry stitched seam by seam, pearls placed one at a time, florals built petal by petal.
home.filmMaking: The making of a ROYA gown
home.altCorset: Inside the Noir corset, boning and pearl waistline
home.quote: “I can’t get over how gorgeous it is. Not only on the outside, but the inside is just as neat and beautiful. And it has my name on it.”
home.boxBody: Matte black, tied in satin ribbon and lined with soft tissue. Every gown arrives this way, with your name on the label inside.
home.boxAlt: The black ROYA box tied with satin ribbon
home.boxAltLabel: A lilac ROYA gown folded in tissue with its label and tag
home.consult1Body: A private appointment with the designer, fabrics in hand. By appointment only.
home.consult2Body: Measurements and fittings at your residence, anywhere in the UAE.
home.consult3Body: A live consultation with the designer, from anywhere in the world.
home.closingAlt: ROYA, Wear Your Dream, in silver foil on black
